documentation.file_docstring:
Composable workflow bundles for the agent marketplace.

Bundles package related agents, skills, tools, and knowledge resources
into a single deployable unit with shared dependencies and governance.
member_docstrings: ComponentType: Type of component within a workflow bundle.
BundleComponent: A single component within a workflow bundle.
WorkflowBundle: A composable bundle of marketplace components.
BundleValidationError: Raised when a workflow bundle fails validation.
BundleRegistry: Registry for managing workflow bundles.

register: Register a workflow bundle.

Raises ``BundleValidationError`` if validation fail
get: Retrieve a bundle by name and version.
validate_bundle: Validate a bundle and return a list of error messages (empty = valid).
search: Search bundles optionally filtered by component type.
